election.//: electionId is UNKNOWN until Dane County posts the Aug 11 2026 primary. Set it here or via ELECTION_ID env var. null = the backend reports 'election not yet published' instead of guessing.
election.//raceMatch: The race is found by matching this pattern against the county's race list, so the race number does not need to be known in advance. In 2024 the equivalent race was named 'DEM Representative to the Assembly District 76'.
election.//expectedCandidates: Used ONLY before the county publishes the race, so the legend/table show real names and empty structure instead of blank space. Never used as vote data. Once the scrape succeeds, the county's own candidate list replaces this entirely. Order here sets pre-election palette order only.

source.//mode: 'api' uses the api.danecounty.gov JSON Election endpoints — the election-night default, because the HTML host refuses datacenter IPs via Cloudflare and the JSON is the same backing data. 'html' scrapes elections.danecounty.gov only. 'auto' tries html first and falls back to api. See README 'Data sources'.
source.userAgent: AD76-results-map/1.0 (+ward-level results display; contact: repo owner)

polling.//: Backend owns the schedule. idleIntervalMs applies while every tracked race shows 0 wards reporting; activeIntervalMs applies as soon as reportingThreshold wards have reported.

candidates.//: Single source of truth for candidate colors, shared by the map, the legend and the table. lockedColors matches on normalized surname/full name; everyone else takes paletteOrder in the order the scrape returns them. Changing the field of candidates is an edit here, nowhere else.
candidates.//writeIn: Write-in lines are real results and are counted in totals, but are not given a palette colour or a map hue.

margin.//: Shared saturation scale used for every candidate. A ward won by >= fullStrengthMargin renders at full opacity; a ward won by <= lightestMargin renders at minOpacity.
